chunks.title: Remote and Hybrid Work
chunks.text: Eligible employees may work remotely or on a hybrid schedule with manager approval. Field-project staff work on-site as required by the project schedule.

chunks.title: Paid Time Off (PTO)
chunks.text: Full-time employees accrue paid time off (PTO) based on years of service, beginning at 15 days per year and increasing to 20 days after five years. PTO is separate from the leaves of absence described in Section LV-4.

chunks.title: Parking and Commuter Benefits
chunks.text: Northwind provides on-site parking at the Austin and San Jose offices at no charge and offers a monthly commuter subsidy for employees who use public transit. Parking at client and field-project sites is arranged per project.

chunks.title: Code of Conduct
chunks.text: All employees are expected to act with integrity, treat colleagues and clients with respect, and comply with company policies and applicable law. Violations may result in disciplinary action up to and including termination.
